notes.title: State Of The Game
notes.content: [h2]Game rewrite[/h2][p] Over the past year or so, the game has become increasingly complex to the point where small issues are hard to fix due to the spaghetti code (my fault). As a result, I’ll be rewriting the entire game from scratch, which will delay its release by possibly a year. [/p][p]Alongside the five existing levels (stages), I’ll be adding new ones and improving support for modding,  [/p]
